evidence.meaning: Official event time field, with CUDA records selected by event kind.
GPU profiles attribute descendant CUDA GPU time to host frames.
GPU flamegraphs use GPU time and relative percentages.

derivation: For each accepted worker/GPU CUDA event, fraction = c / sum(c). Any common base-time unit cancels. Percent = 100 * fraction. Width is proportional to time rather than the number of records.
limits: The public JSON schema does not state an absolute unit. No seconds-to-milliseconds conversion is made.
The native UI duration formatter uses seconds, but its binary payload is separate from this JSON API.
These are exported attributed GPU-time shares. No undocumented sampling compensation or whole-run extrapolation is assumed.
